children: Medallion announced a public offering to reopen its Series G fixed-rate reset non‑cumulative perpetual preferred stock and may use proceeds to redeem Series E.
Medallion Bank launched a public offering of additional Series G preferred stock, reopening the May 22, 2025 issue.
Series G is fixed-rate reset, non‑cumulative perpetual preferred with $25 liquidation amount per share, traded as MBNKO.
Underwriters granted a 30‑day option to buy additional shares to cover over‑allotments, if any.
Net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes and possibly redeeming some or all outstanding Series E, subject to FDIC approval.
Offering exempt from Securities Act registration under Section 3(a)(2) and will be made by offering circular available at medallionbankoffering.com.
